title: Why Generate a Click? Plug-in Decision Heads for Web Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.20107v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web agents built on vision language models decide every action by generating text such as click(12), although most of that text encodes a choice among a few action types and a few dozen marked elements. We read these choices directly from the hidden states that the generator computes while it reads the goal and the screenshot. Plug-in decision heads on a frozen generator predict the action type, pool the visual tokens inside each numbered box to pick the target, and point at a listed text option or at a WRITE slot that leaves the writing of new text to the generator. A confidence cascade executes the heads' action when they are sure and otherwise lets the generator decode from the KV cache of the same forward pass. translated_title: 为什么要生成一次“点击”？面向网页智能体的即插即用决策头
translated_abstract: 基于视觉语言模型构建的网页智能体通过生成文本来决定每一个动作，例如 click(12)，尽管这些文本的大部分内容只是在少数动作类型和几十个被标记元素之间做出的选择。我们直接从生成器在读取目标和屏幕截图时计算出的隐藏状态中读取这些选择。在冻结的生成器上添加即插即用的决策头，用于预测动作类型，对每个编号框内的视觉词元进行池化以选取目标，并指向列出的文本选项，或指向一个 WRITE 槽位——将撰写新文本的任务留给生成器。置信度级联机制在决策头有把握时执行其动作，否则让生成器从同一次前向传播的 KV 缓存中解码。使用在 21.3 万个网页步骤上训练的 Qwen3-VL 4B 和 8B 生成器，严格的阈值使级联方法在七个离线测试集上保持比生成器低 0.3 个百分点到高 1.4 个百分点之间的性能，同时决策头决定了其中 12% 到 64% 的动作。
tldr: 该论文提出在冻结的视觉语言模型上外挂即插即用决策头，直接从隐藏状态中读取动作类型、目标元素和文本选项，并通过置信度级联在高置信时跳过文本生成，从而在不损失（甚至略提升）性能的前提下大幅加速网页智能体的决策。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes plug-in decision heads on a frozen vision language model that read action type, target element, and text option choices directly from hidden states, with a confidence cascade that skips text decoding when the heads are confident, enabling web agent decisions with comparable or slightly better performance while drastically reducing generation.
